candidates.headline: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
candidates.snippet: Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon for long-horizon software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and defensive cybersecurity, with a phased rollout and expanded long-output reasoning.

candidates.headline: Build a multi-agent music production pipeline on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime Instances
candidates.snippet: AWS shows a multi-agent architecture where several specialized agents coordinate through AgentCore Runtime Instances, illustrating runtime and orchestration requirements beyond a single agent.

candidates.headline: Implementing Multi-Environment Access for Claude Platform on AWS
candidates.snippet: AWS describes a governed access design for Claude Platform on AWS across production workloads, developer laptops, and other environments, focusing on identity and environment boundaries.

candidates.headline: Uplifting conversion across the acquisition funnel with personalization using contextual bandits on AWS
candidates.snippet: AWS presents a practical acquisition workflow combining generative content production with contextual-bandit personalization and measurement across the funnel.

candidates.headline: How uniopen customized Amazon Nova to their retail moderation policies for production deployment
candidates.snippet: AWS describes how uniopen adapted a model to its own retail moderation policy and deployment workflow rather than relying on a generic moderation layer.

candidates.headline: Work IQ: Business and workplace intelligence in the flow of work
candidates.snippet: Microsoft says Work IQ grounds Copilot and agents in productivity and business data, with Dynamics 365 and Power Platform grounding entering preview starting September 30.

candidates.headline: Introducing dots
candidates.snippet: OpenAI introduced Dots as always-on agents with their own cloud computer, feedback-driven personalization, and plugin connections designed to handle continuing responsibilities.

candidates.headline: Perplexity and American Express make AI easier for growing businesses
candidates.snippet: Perplexity and American Express introduced ten pre-built business Skills for Computer covering finance, marketing, operations, and hiring; Skills package reusable instructions for recurring work.

candidates.headline: 21 Things We Announced at Dreamforce 2026
candidates.snippet: Salesforce announced long-horizon Agentforce agents with persistent memory, durable execution, and dynamic steering, plus an Agent Optimizer for finding recurring failures and staging improvements.
